answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 44341 Country: India Title: Leather Socks with cotton socks Question: Is it necessary to wear the leather socks over the cotton socks or it can be used bare footed? Answer ID: 44341 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 424/397/N=1434) You can wear the leather socks only, it is not necessary to wear cotton socks inside them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
